description.value: Andes Latin Foods is a Venezuelan-family-owned Latin mini market and coffee shop serving the Port Moody community. Their menu spans multiple South American countries, offering Colombian, Peruvian, Argentine, and Venezuelan empanadas alongside tequeños, pão de queijo, and fresh-pressed fruit juices. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a culturally distinctive spot for a hot snack or coffee with a genuine Latin American flavour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is real, open, and operating as a Latin mini market and coffee shop at 2727 Clarke St, Port Moody, BC — but OSM lists the community as 'North Vancouver', which contradicts the website's explicit 'Port Moody BC' location claim. Phone and email match OSM exactly. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; the 'Latin Mini Market' homepage label confirms a grocery component, and the menu lists fried/baked prepared foods (empanadas, tequeños, aborrajado) supporting a hot food claim.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business website explicitly states the location is 'Port Moody, BC' — address contact_confirmed set to false. The OSM record may be mis-attributed to the wrong municipality.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Latin mini market and coffee shop with an active website and confirmed contact details. Useful to touring cyclists as a food and snack stop.

Hot food.detail: Menu includes fried and baked prepared foods: aborrajado (deep-fried plantain), Venezuelan/Colombian/Peruvian/Argentinian empanadas (fried or baked), tequeños (fried cheese sticks), and almojábana/pandebono baked goods

wow_evidence: Venezuelan-family-owned Latin mini market and coffee shop
